events.title: Demo Launch September 1st
events.summary: The Demo Launches September 1st!Posted by: That One Guy Loki from That One Game StudioThe day has finally come that the demo will be launching. After over a year of development and months of public playtesting we have made it. I'm excited to announce that Pocket Racer Shop Sim's Demo launches Tuesday, September 1st!The wait is only 3 days.I have been working heavily on refining the demo from all the playtest feedback. The biggest bit of feedback I received was around the multiplayer experience.
